title: If your startup was a movie...
intro: Every business has a genre. Yours is showing whether you meant it to or not.
og_line: Five questions and the film your business is quietly remaking.

cta.title: Something a bit more serious
cta.label: The Energy Discovery
cta.blurb: That one was for fun. The Energy Discovery is 48 statements and returns how you actually work across all twelve energies.

questions.q: The best thing about your business right now:

options.a: It should not work and it does
The thing itself is really good
We pulled off something last month

questions.q: Your last big win came from:

options.a: A deadline that should have killed us
Whoever is needed for this one
Proving they were wrong about me
Whether we are building the right thing
Everything, because it is all mine

questions.q: How does the third act go?

options.a: I go the distance either way
Enormous, one way or the other
It works, and it changes who is in it
I answer the door and let someone in

results.name: Rocky
results.headline: Nobody picked you, and you went the distance.
results.body: You were not the obvious choice and you are still standing, which is the entire point. The training montage is just your Tuesday.
results.cost: You have started to enjoy being the underdog more than winning would feel.

results.name: The Wolf of Wall Street
results.headline: Loud, fast, and it is working.
results.body: The energy is enormous and the numbers keep going up. Everyone in the room is slightly out of breath.
results.cost: Nobody in the room is asking the boring question about whether this holds.

results.name: The Social Network
results.headline: Built brilliantly, at a cost.
results.body: The product is genuinely good and you know it. The complicated part was never the code.
results.cost: Look at who is still in the founding group photo.

results.name: Mission Impossible
results.headline: Impossible deadline, somehow met.
results.body: You do your best work when the timer is already running. Every launch has one moment nobody outside the team knows about.
results.cost: You have started creating the emergencies yourself.

results.name: Home Alone
results.headline: Small, alone, and improvising brilliantly.
results.body: It is you, some tools and a lot of ingenuity. The traps you build out of nothing are genuinely impressive.
results.cost: You have made being alone part of the identity, which makes help hard to accept.
